mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name AS user_name FROM t_user u WHERE u.status = 'NORMAL'

SELECT m.user_id, u.name AS user_name, m.farm_id, f.name AS farm_name, m.role FROM t_farm_member m JOIN t_farm f ON f.id = m.farm_id AND f.deleted = 0 AND f.audit_status = 'APPROVED' JOIN t_user u ON u.id = m.user_id AND u.status = 'NORMAL' WHERE m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.active_flag = 1 ORDER BY m.user_id, m.farm_id

SELECT m.user_id, u.name AS user_name, m.farm_id, f.name AS farm_name, m.role FROM t_farm_member m JOIN t_farm f ON f.id = m.farm_id JOIN t_user u ON u.id = m.user_id AND u.status = 'NORMAL' WHERE m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.active_flag = 1 AND f.deleted = 0 AND f.audit_status = 'APPROVED' AND f.id IN #{farmId} ORDER BY m.user_id, m.farm_id
SELECT f.id AS farm_id, f.name, f.adcode, f.main_category_id, f.audit_status, f.disabled, f.frozen FROM t_farm f WHERE f.deleted = 0 AND f.id IN #{id} ORDER BY f.id

SELECT f.id AS farm_id, f.name, f.adcode, f.main_category_id, f.audit_status, f.disabled, f.frozen FROM t_farm f WHERE f.deleted = 0 AND f.audit_status = 'APPROVED' AND f.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY f.id LIMIT 50
